descriptions.w3d_d26a_emitters_setup_800370cc: Allocates and creates ten emitters (0x801fe1d8, 0x8025dffc with name FE.NewBox.Blue and id 28 + index % 5), stores them at +36, configures each through 0x8025e128 and places it with 0x8025ee60, adding (20, -20, 0) to the start position (-150, 150, 0) each time.
